payload.title: 8 Lake Como Villas You Can Book for an Exclusive-Use Wedding
payload.excerpt: For a Lake Como villa wedding, exclusive use means the whole property is yours: house, gardens, dock and bedrooms, closed to everyone but your guests. Not every famous name on the lake offers it. Some are hotels that host weddings in their function rooms; some are heritage gardens with no bedrooms.
key_takeaways: Eight villas on our shortlist could be confirmed as bookable for exclusive use from their own official sources. Several are boutique hotels that offer a whole-property option rather than private homes. None publishes an exclusive-use fee, so start with [what a Lake Como wedding costs](/expert-advice/how-much-does-a-lake-como-wedding-cost).

Beds, not dinner seats, are the limit. Where they publish figures, these villas seat about 70 to 200 for dinner but sleep 12 to about 40, so most Australian guest lists need a nearby room block as well.

A legal civil ceremony on site is the exception: Villa Làrio and Relais Villa Vittoria state it, Varenna's tourism site lists Villa Cipressi (on a 2024 page), and Villa Lario Resort offers a symbolic ceremony.
Australians marrying in Italy need a Nulla Osta, sworn in person at the Australian Embassy in Rome or the Consulate-General in Milan. A Certificate of No Impediment is not accepted.
Minimum nights, music curfews and standing capacity are rarely published. Get them in writing for your dates before you commit.

faq.q: Can you get legally married at a Lake Como villa?
faq.a: Yes, at some. Villa Làrio says it is licensed for civil ceremonies with legal effect, and Relais Villa Vittoria serves as a municipal wedding location run with the Comune di Laglio. Varenna's tourism site also lists Villa Cipressi (page dated July 2024). Elsewhere, hold a symbolic ceremony at the villa and the legal one at a town hall. Smartraveller says a marriage valid where it took place is, in most cases, legally recognised in Australia. Your Wedded Advisor confirms current requirements.

faq.q: How many nights do exclusive-use villas on Lake Como require?
faq.a: Most do not publish a minimum. Villa Aura del Lago states three nights for weddings. For every other villa, ask for the minimum stay on your dates before you commit.

faq.q: Is there a music curfew at Lake Como villas, and where does the party go after?
faq.a: None of the eight publishes a curfew time, so ask each one. Relais Villa Vittoria's wine cellar becomes a private disco under whole-villa hire.

faq.q: Can all our guests stay at the villa?
faq.a: Usually not. Those that publish a figure sleep from 12 (Villa Sola Cabiati) to about 40 (Villa Pliniana). Plan a nearby room block for everyone else.

faq.q: What happens if it rains on our Lake Como villa wedding?
faq.a: Relais Villa Vittoria moves ceremony and dinner into the Salone, with exclusive hire. Villa Lario Resort uses its hall, veranda or marquee. Agree the rain plan, and when you will call it, at booking.

faq.q: Can you book Villa d'Este or Villa del Balbianello for exclusive use?
faq.a: Villa d'Este is an operating hotel, and its official events page does not describe a whole-property buyout. Villa del Balbianello is a FAI property that hosts weddings of up to 130 guests but has no overnight rooms.
